title: Houston music school faces allegations after staff say they go unpaid for months
text:
Vivaldi Music Academy faces allegations after staff report unpaid wages dating back to March.
Vivaldi Music Academy, a music school with multiple locations across the Houston area, is under fire as several current and former employees allege they haven’t received paychecks, some for months. Five former staff members hired in June say their roles as assistant directors were suddenly reclassified to "student concierge," and that their paychecks, originally scheduled for June 17, never arrived.
To Be Clear:We are proud of our students and faculty for having a vibrant and enriching experience, with many set to perform in Amsterdam next month. We also hosted a full series of recitals over the last few weeks, with over 1,000 students of all ages participating.We remain committed to an open dialogue for students, staff, faculty and the members of the community.
